title: Nvidia approaches Arm Holdings CEO Haas to take over Jensen Huang's job, Elon Musk backs Huang's reinstatement
summary: According to Financial Times, citing people familiar with the matter, Haas, who has headed the SoftBank-backed British chipmaker since 2022, is among the names being considered by Nvidia's board as it explores leadership options following Huang's departure.
llm_summary: Nvidia’s board is reportedly scouting new leadership after CEO Jensen Huang announced his exit, and one of the top candidates being approached is Arm Holdings chief Peter Haas, who has led the SoftBank‑backed chipmaker since 2022.
